title: A Sudakov--Fernique proof of Lehner-type edge bounds for matrix-valued GUE sums
summary: Let $A_0,A_1,\ldots,A_n\in M_N(\mathbb{C})$ be Hermitian matrices and let $G_1,\ldots,G_n$ be independent $M\times M$ GUE matrices normalized so that $\|M^{-1/2}G_i\|\to 2$ almost surely as $M\to\infty$. We study the spectral edges and operator norm of $H_M = A_0\otimes I_M + \frac{1}{\sqrt{M}}\sum_{i=1}^n A_i\otimes G_i$. Lehner's formula identifies the right and left edges of the corresponding free semicircular operator as $ρ_+ = \inf_{Z\succ 0}λ_{\max}(A_0+Z+\sum_{i=1}^n A_iZ^{-1}A_i)$ and $ρ_- = \sup_{Z\prec 0}λ_{\min}(A_0+Z+\sum_{i=1}^n A_iZ^{-1}A_i)$.
